experience.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
base_bullets: Develop and deploy software automation that streamlines repetitive operational processes, improves production efficiency, and increases the reliability and consistency of business-critical applications and supporting infrastructure.

Lead troubleshooting of complex production incidents by analyzing application behavior, system health, and infrastructure dependencies, coordinating recovery activities, and contributing technical findings to post-mortem reviews that help prevent recurring service disruptions.

Design and improve monitoring frameworks that provide actionable visibility into application health, infrastructure performance, and service behavior, supporting proactive issue detection, performance optimization, capacity planning, and long-term platform reliability.
Drive continuous reliability improvements by identifying operational bottlenecks, recurring failure patterns, and opportunities for automation across supported application environments.

Support fulfillment of SLAs and SLOs by monitoring service performance, availability, and operational health across highly available cloud platforms while helping engineering teams address conditions that could affect reliability.
Optimize application and infrastructure performance through monitoring, troubleshooting, capacity analysis, and operational improvements aligned with reliability engineering objectives.
Provide 24x7 production support coverage, responding to service disruptions and working across application and infrastructure layers to restore stable operations.
Build deep technical expertise across assigned application suites, enabling faster diagnosis of production issues and more effective collaboration with engineering and operations teams.
Participate in incident reviews and operational improvement initiatives, translating lessons from production issues into practical improvements to automation, monitoring, and system stability.

Identified infrastructure design gaps and recommended architecture improvements that strengthened scalability, maintainability, resiliency, and operational readiness across production environments.
Supported cloud and platform environments through rotational on-call responsibilities, troubleshooting infrastructure and application issues and helping maintain service continuity.
Monitored implementation of organizational technology policies, standards, and procedures across infrastructure environments to support consistent and controlled platform operations.
Collaborated across engineering, infrastructure, networking, and operations teams to resolve production issues and support reliable delivery of enterprise applications and services.
Improved operational consistency by applying automation and repeatable infrastructure processes across deployment, environment management, and production-support activities.

Supported continuous improvement of cloud and platform operations by evaluating existing infrastructure practices, identifying technical risks, and recommending practical enhancements to reliability and service performance.
